name: TuitionFinder
description: Clean, simple tutoring marketplace for Pakistan with platform-enforced escrow payments. 80/20 split: tutors get 80%, platform takes 20% for security and verification.
design: Minimal Android shell, 4-tab navigation, single-screen modals, no clutter
payments: JazzCash / EasyPaisa / Raast — all payments held in platform escrow. No cash. No off-platform deals. 80% to tutor, 20% platform commission.
features: Home — quick actions, active sessions, recent messages
Find — search tutors/students by subject, location, budget
Chat — DM with built-in price negotiation and deal lock
escrow: All monthly tuition held in escrow. Released only after 30-day session verification. QR codes for attendance. 80/20 split.
